title: Proper counit is invertible on the distinguished open component
statement: For every M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)), the pullback along c.i of the proper derived counit for r.hom at the c.i-extension of M is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 0F7B and 0F7I, clopen restriction to the distinguished section.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing theorem for this refinement-specific derived counit was found; the component decomposes into this counit and the pullback compositor.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Split off as the geometric counit substep.

from.place: Clopen distinguished-section calculation of the proper counit factor.

proof.text: Form the refinement fibre product over d.Z. The pullback of the c.i-extension by the first projection is extension by zero from the clopen distinguished section induced by c.i. The open restriction counit identifies restriction of the proper direct image with the direct image of this section restriction, and the identified open-closed calculation makes the latter counit invertible. Transport this ordinary counit through the exact K-injective-preserving open pullback and the derived pullback composition comparison.

lean.statement: theorem refinementProperCounit_isIso (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X))) : IsIso ((pull R c.i).map ((proEtaleRingDerivedAdjunction r.hom (R.ring d.Z) (R.ring c.Z) (R.pull r.hom)).counit.app ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)))
